God willing, exalted is He.
We ask God to grant success.
And God is the granter of success.
And through God comes success.

May God forgive you, my father.

entries.target: صلى الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.expandedArabic: صلى الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.accessibleEnglish: The source preserves a damaged repeated blessing for the Prophet.

entries.source: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من سخطك
entries.target: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من سخطك
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من سخطك
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, I seek refuge in You from Your displeasure.
And God, the Exalted, knows best.
Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds.
And knowledge is with God, the Exalted.

entries.referentScope: the commander praised in the verse
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God reward the commander with good.
May God bless you.
Thus God, the Exalted, knows best.
God is greatest; God is greatest.
O God, set Your dog upon him.
With the help of God, the Exalted.

entries.source: حفظك الله من بين يديك ومن خلفك وعن يمينك وعن شمالك ومن فوقك ومن تحتك وأدرأ عنك شرور الإنس والجن
entries.target: حفظك الله من بين يديك ومن خلفك وعن يمينك وعن شمالك ومن فوقك ومن تحتك وأدرأ عنك شرور الإنس والجن
entries.expandedArabic: حفظك الله من بين يديك ومن خلفك وعن يمينك وعن شمالك ومن فوقك ومن تحتك وأدرأ عنك شرور الإنس والجن
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God protect you from before you and behind you, from your right and your left, and from above you and beneath you, and ward off from you the evils of humankind and jinn.
May God not raise you.

entries.source: لا رفعه الله إن لم يسد إلا قومه
entries.target: لا رفعه الله إن لم يسد إلا قومه
entries.expandedArabic: لا رفعه الله إن لم يسد إلا قومه
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God not raise him if he rules none but his own people.
Peace be upon you.
May God bless you.
O God, destroy them and root them out.

entries.referentScope: the speaker's group and the enemy group
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, grant us victory over them.
We seek refuge in God from grave sin.

entries.source: اللهم لا أحل لهم أن يكذبوا علي
entries.target: اللهم لا أحل لهم أن يكذبوا علي
entries.referentScope: God and those who might lie about the speaker
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم لا أحل لهم أن يكذبوا علي
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, I do not permit them to lie about me.

entries.source: رضيت بالله ربا وبالإسلام دينا وبمحمد نبيا
entries.target: رضيت بالله ربا وبالإسلام دينا وبمحمد نبيا
entries.expandedArabic: رضيت بالله ربا وبالإسلام دينا وبمحمد نبيا
entries.accessibleEnglish: I am content with God as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muḥammad as Prophet.
And God—glory be to Him, the Exalted—knows best.

entries.source: اللهم اشغل عني عامرا كيف شئت وأنى شئت واهد بني عامر
entries.target: اللهم اشغل عني عامرا كيف شئت وأنى شئت واهد بني عامر
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular supplication with masculine singular and plural objects
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم اشغل عني عامرا كيف شئت وأنى شئت واهد بني عامر
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, occupy ʿĀmir away from me however and wherever You will, and guide Banū ʿĀmir.

entries.source: الحمد لله الذي استنقذني به من النار
entries.target: الحمد لله الذي استنقذني به من النار
entries.expandedArabic: الحمد لله الذي استنقذني به من النار
entries.accessibleEnglish: Praise belongs to God, who saved me through him from the Fire.
May God hasten your appointed time.

entries.source: يا رب لا آلو إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.target: يا رب لا آلو إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular address to God
entries.expandedArabic: يا رب لا آلو إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.accessibleEnglish: My Lord, I spare no effort except in what is beyond me.

entries.source: يا رب ما آلوا إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.target: يا رب ما آلوا إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular address to God
entries.expandedArabic: يا رب ما آلوا إلا ما عجزت عنه
entries.accessibleEnglish: My Lord, I spare no effort except in what is beyond me.
Glory be to God.
May God recompense me on account of ʿUthmān.

entries.source: جزى الله خيرا علايا من عشيرة
entries.target: جزى الله خيرا علايا من عشيرة
entries.expandedArabic: جزى الله خيرا علايا من عشيرة
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God reward with good the ʿAlāyā of the clan.
May God honor his face.

entries.referentScope: the she-camel that carried the speaker
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God curse the she-camel that carried me to you.

entries.target: لوى يده الله الذي هو غالبه
entries.referentScope: the man addressed in the verse
entries.expandedArabic: لوى يده الله الذي هو غالبه
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God, who overcomes him, twist his hand.
God is greatest.
Amen.
May God fight him.
May God reward you for your words.
May God disgrace whoever lies.
May God prolong your life, O Muʿammar.
O God, forgive me and have mercy on me.
O God, accept my repentance.
Praise belongs to God; He has no partner.
May God preserve your mouth and teeth.
May God have mercy on Nāfiʿ ibn Budayl.

entries.expandedArabic: اللهم أمكني من نبهان في عنقه حبل أنوف
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, deliver Nabhān into my power with a coarse rope around his neck.
The source preserves a damaged spelling of the declaration, “There is no deity except God.”

entries.source: اللهم أمكني من نبهان في عنقه حبل أسود
entries.target: اللهم أمكني من نبهان في عنقه حبل أسود
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم أمكني من نبهان في عنقه حبل أسود
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, deliver Nabhān into my power with a black rope around his neck.
O God, increase him in steadfastness.

entries.source: الحمد لله الذي أكرمنا بالإسلام ومن علينا بمحمد ولم نمت على ما مات عليه الآباء

entries.accessibleEnglish: Praise belongs to God, who honored us with Islam, favored us with Muḥammad, and did not let us die upon what the forefathers died upon.

entries.referentScope: the immediately preceding ill male referent
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, grant immediate healing.

entries.source: أقسمت عليك يا رب لا تغيب الشمس حتى أطأ بعرجتي في خضر الجنة
entries.target: أقسمت عليك يا رب لا تغيب الشمس حتى أطأ بعرجتي في خضر الجنة
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular direct oath and supplication
entries.expandedArabic: أقسمت عليك يا رب لا تغيب الشمس حتى أطأ بعرجتي في خضر الجنة
entries.accessibleEnglish: I adjure You, my Lord: do not let the sun set until I tread, with my limp, in the greenery of Paradise.
There is no deity except God.

entries.source: عفا الله عما كان في الشرك
entries.target: عفا الله عما كان في الشرك
entries.expandedArabic: عفا الله عما كان في الشرك

entries.target: اللهم انك تعلم أني أسلمت طائعا وقد خرجت مجاهدا أريد وجهك فأحي لي حماري ولا تجعل لأحد على منة

entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular with masculine singular object
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم انك تعلم أني أسلمت طائعا وقد خرجت مجاهدا أريد وجهك فأحي لي حماري ولا تجعل لأحد على منة
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, You know that I embraced Islam willingly and went out striving, seeking Your countenance; revive my donkey for me and do not place anyone under an obligation to me.
May God prolong your life.

entries.source: السلام عليك يا نبي الله ورحمة الله وبركاته
entries.target: السلام عليك يا نبي الله ورحمة الله وبركاته
entries.expandedArabic: السلام عليك يا نبي الله ورحمة الله وبركاته

And upon you be peace and God's mercy.
And upon him be peace, God's mercy, and His blessings.
And upon you be peace, O Humāmah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of God.

entries.target: اللهم سلط عليه كلبا من كلابك
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم سلط عليه كلبا من كلابك
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, set upon him a dog from among Your dogs.
We ask God for martyrdom.
O God, remove rancor and envy from him.

entries.target: رضي الله عنك وغفر لك يا رسول الله
entries.expandedArabic: رضي الله عنك وغفر لك يا رسول الله
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God be pleased with you and forgive you, O Messenger of God.
O God, give him a tremor.

entries.target: كبك الله على وجهك في النار
entries.expandedArabic: كبك الله على وجهك في النار
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God throw you face-first into the Fire.

entries.referentScope: the contextually supplied object and male referent
entries.grammaticalAgreement: masculine singular pronoun with an elided object
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, break [it] with him.

entries.source: اللهم شفع البكائين فيمن لم يبك
entries.target: اللهم شفع البكائين فيمن لم يبك
entries.referentScope: those who weep and those who do not weep
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم شفع البكائين فيمن لم يبك
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, allow those who weep to intercede for those who do not weep.
God forbid; refuge is with God.

entries.source: بسم الله أعوذ بكلمات الله من غضبه وعقابه وشر عباده ومن همزات الشياطين وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون
entries.target: بسم الله أعوذ بكلمات الله من غضبه وعقابه وشر عباده ومن همزات الشياطين وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون
entries.expandedArabic: بسم الله أعوذ بكلمات الله من غضبه وعقابه وشر عباده ومن همزات الشياطين وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون
entries.accessibleEnglish: In the name of God, I seek refuge in God's words from His wrath and punishment, the evil of His servants, and the promptings of devils; and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they attend me.

entries.source: اللهم أنج الوليد بن الوليد والمستضعفين من المؤمنين
entries.target: اللهم أنج الوليد بن الوليد والمستضعفين من المؤمنين
entries.referentScope: al-Walīd ibn al-Walīd and the oppressed believers
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم أنج الوليد بن الوليد والمستضعفين من المؤمنين
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, rescue al-Walīd ibn al-Walīd and the oppressed believers.

entries.grammaticalAgreement: third person masculine singular with first person singular possessive
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God make him my companion in Paradise.

entries.source: اللهم أكثر رجالهم وأقل آثامهم ولا تحوجهم
entries.target: اللهم أكثر رجالهم وأقل آثامهم ولا تحوجهم
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم أكثر رجالهم وأقل آثامهم ولا تحوجهم
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, increase their men, lessen their sins, and keep them from need.

entries.source: الحمد لله يا أشعث الذي نصر دينه وأعز نبيه وأدخلك وقومك في هذا الدين كارهين
entries.target: الحمد لله يا أشعث الذي نصر دينه وأعز نبيه وأدخلك وقومك في هذا الدين كارهين
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second person masculine singular address within a praise declaration
entries.expandedArabic: الحمد لله يا أشعث الذي نصر دينه وأعز نبيه وأدخلك وقومك في هذا الدين كارهين
entries.accessibleEnglish: Praise belongs to God, O Ashʿath, who gave victory to His religion, strengthened His Prophet, and brought you and your people into this religion unwillingly.

entries.referentScope: the father of the immediately addressed person
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God have mercy on your father.

entries.source: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك وأنت غني عن عذابه ان كان محسنا فزد في إحسانه وان كان مسيئا فتجاوز عنه
entries.target: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك وأنت غني عن عذابه ان كان محسنا فزد في إحسانه وان كان مسيئا فتجاوز عنه
entries.grammaticalAgreement: third person masculine singular in a direct address to God
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك وأنت غني عن عذابه ان كان محسنا فزد في إحسانه وان كان مسيئا فتجاوز عنه
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, Your servant and the son of Your servant has come to need Your mercy, while You have no need to punish him. If he did good, increase his good; and if he did wrong, pardon him.

entries.source: يا رب هذا قتلني عبثا فلا هو انتفع بقتلي ولا هو تركني أعيش في أرضك
entries.target: يا رب هذا قتلني عبثا فلا هو انتفع بقتلي ولا هو تركني أعيش في أرضك
entries.referentScope: God, the killed bird, and its killer
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first person singular complaint addressed to God
entries.expandedArabic: يا رب هذا قتلني عبثا فلا هو انتفع بقتلي ولا هو تركني أعيش في أرضك
entries.accessibleEnglish: My Lord, this one killed me wantonly: neither did he benefit from killing me nor did he leave me to live on Your earth.
I seek God's forgiveness.

entries.source: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك
entries.target: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك
entries.grammaticalAgreement: third person masculine singular in a direct address to God
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك
entries.accessibleEnglish: O God, Your servant and the son of Your servant has come to need Your mercy.

entries.source: الحمد لله رب العالمين حمدا لا نهاية له
entries.target: الحمد لله رب العالمين حمدا لا نهاية له
entries.expandedArabic: الحمد لله رب العالمين حمدا لا نهاية له
entries.accessibleEnglish: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, with praise that has no end.

entries.source: صلى الله على سيدنا محمد وآله وصحبه وسلم تسليما كثيرا آمين
entries.target: صلى الله على سيدنا محمد وآله وصحبه وسلم تسليما كثيرا آمين
entries.referentScope: Muḥammad, his family, and his Companions
entries.grammaticalAgreement: masculine singular with family and companion inclusion
entries.expandedArabic: صلى الله على سيدنا محمد وآله وصحبه وسلم تسليما كثيرا آمين
entries.accessibleEnglish: May God bless our master Muḥammad, his family, and his Companions, and grant abundant peace. Amen.

entries.referentScope: the speakers' belief in Allah, His books, and His messengers
entries.accessibleEnglish: We believe in Allah, His books, and His messengers.

entries.source: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب اليه
entries.target: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب اليه
entries.referentScope: the singular speaker seeking forgiveness from Allah and repenting to Him
entries.expandedArabic: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب اليه
entries.accessibleEnglish: I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

entries.source: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ثم أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله
entries.target: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ثم أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله
entries.referentScope: the speaker's testimony, ending with Muhammad's messengership
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person singular; an internal damaged gap is preserved
entries.expandedArabic: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ثم أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله
entries.accessibleEnglish: I bear witness that … then I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

entries.source: أشهد ان لا اله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله
entries.target: أشهد ان لا اله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله
entries.referentScope: the speaker's testimony to Allah's oneness and Muhammad's messengership
entries.expandedArabic: أشهد ان لا اله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله
entries.accessibleEnglish: I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

entries.referentScope: the singular speaker seeking Allah's protection from the Fire
entries.accessibleEnglish: I seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.

entries.referentScope: the praying community addressing Allah about themselves
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second-person masculine singular divine addressee; first-person plural speakers
entries.accessibleEnglish: You created us, and we are Your servants.

entries.source: إن الله هو السلام وعلى جبريل السلام
entries.target: إن الله هو السلام وعلى جبريل السلام
entries.referentScope: Allah as al-Salam and Gabriel as the recipient of peace
entries.expandedArabic: إن الله هو السلام وعلى جبريل السلام
entries.accessibleEnglish: Indeed Allah is Peace, and peace be upon Gabriel.
Indeed, we belong to Allah.
Praise be to Allah.

entries.referentScope: the Messenger of Allah as the singular saluted referent
entries.accessibleEnglish: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.

entries.referentScope: Allah as the ultimate possessor of knowledge
entries.accessibleEnglish: Knowledge rests with Allah.

entries.referentScope: Allah and His Messenger as the coordinated knowers
entries.grammaticalAgreement: coordinated divine and masculine singular prophetic referents
entries.accessibleEnglish: Allah and His Messenger know best.
O Allah.

entries.source: اللهم إني أحب لقاءك فأحبب لقائي
entries.target: اللهم إني أحب لقاءك فأحبب لقائي
entries.referentScope: Abu Hurayrah addressing Allah about their meeting
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person masculine singular speaker; singular divine addressee
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم إني أحب لقاءك فأحبب لقائي
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, I love to meet You, so love to meet me.

entries.source: اللهم ارحم أمي اللهم اغفر لأمي
entries.target: اللهم ارحم أمي اللهم اغفر لأمي
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم ارحم أمي اللهم اغفر لأمي
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, have mercy on my mother; O Allah, forgive my mother.

entries.referentScope: Abu Hurayrah as the requested beneficiary
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, heal Abu Hurayrah.
O Allah, forgive Abd al-Qays.

entries.source: اللهم اغفر للأنصار ولأبناء الأنصار ولأبناء أبناء الأنصار
entries.target: اللهم اغفر للأنصار ولأبناء الأنصار ولأبناء أبناء الأنصار
entries.referentScope: the Ansar, their children, and their grandchildren
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم اغفر للأنصار ولأبناء الأنصار ولأبناء أبناء الأنصار
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, forgive the Ansar, the children of the Ansar, and the children of their children.

entries.source: اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي وأخسىء شيطاني وفك رهاني
entries.target: اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي وأخسىء شيطاني وفك رهاني
entries.referentScope: the singular speaker's sin, devil, and pledged burden
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي وأخسىء شيطاني وفك رهاني
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, forgive my sin, drive away my devil, and release my pledge.
O Allah, guide Abu Hurayrah's mother.

entries.referentScope: Abu Zayd as the beneficiary of beautification
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, beautify him.

entries.source: اللهم رب السماوات السبع وما أظللن ورب الأرضين وما أقللن ورب الشياطين وما أظللن
entries.target: اللهم رب السماوات السبع وما أظللن ورب الأرضين وما أقللن ورب الشياطين وما أظللن
entries.referentScope: Allah as Lord of the seven heavens, the earths, and the devils and what they encompass
entries.grammaticalAgreement: singular divine addressee; feminine plural relative agreement for the created realms
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم رب السماوات السبع وما أظللن ورب الأرضين وما أقللن ورب الشياطين وما أظللن
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade, Lord of the earths and what they bear, and Lord of the devils and what they shade.

entries.referentScope: Abu Hurayrah asking not to live into the year sixty
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, do not let the year sixty overtake me.

entries.referentScope: Abu Hurayrah addressing Allah about the feminine-referenced illness or condition
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person context with a feminine singular object pronoun
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, do not send it back.

entries.source: اللهم نحن عبادك وأنت خلقتنا وأنت ربنا وإليك معادنا
entries.target: اللهم نحن عبادك وأنت خلقتنا وأنت ربنا وإليك معادنا
entries.referentScope: the praying community addressing Allah about servitude, creation, lordship, and return
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person plural speakers; singular divine addressee
entries.expandedArabic: اللهم نحن عبادك وأنت خلقتنا وأنت ربنا وإليك معادنا
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Allah, we are Your servants; You created us; You are our Lord; and to You is our return.

entries.source: باسم الله صلو صلب خير يعود من أفواهها ولا يضر أحد اكشف الباس رب الناس
entries.target: باسم الله صلو صلب خير يعود من أفواهها ولا يضر أحد اكشف الباس رب الناس
entries.referentScope: Allah as healer and a person afflicted by the skin eruption
entries.grammaticalAgreement: singular divine addressee; singular afflicted beneficiary
entries.expandedArabic: باسم الله صلو صلب خير يعود من أفواهها ولا يضر أحد اكشف الباس رب الناس
entries.accessibleEnglish: In the name of Allah … remove the affliction, Lord of humankind. The intervening transmitted wording is textually uncertain.

entries.referentScope: Abu Sabra as the person for whom mercy is requested
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah have mercy on you.

entries.referentScope: the singular speaker affirming Allah as Lord
entries.accessibleEnglish: I am content with Allah as Lord.

entries.referentScope: Allah as the direct object of glorification and praise
entries.accessibleEnglish: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You.

entries.referentScope: Abu al-Qasim, the Prophet, as recipient of God's peace and fragrant favor
entries.accessibleEnglish: God's peace and fragrant favor be upon him.

entries.referentScope: the Messenger of Allah as the singular saluted referent
entries.accessibleEnglish: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.

entries.referentScope: a single male addressee receiving peace
entries.accessibleEnglish: Upon you be peace.

entries.referentScope: Abu al-Qasim, the Prophet, as the singular saluted referent
entries.accessibleEnglish: Upon you be peace, O Abu al-Qasim.

entries.referentScope: Umar as the requested beneficiary of forgiveness
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah forgive Umar.

entries.referentScope: Zaynab bint Jahsh as the requested beneficiary of forgiveness
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second-person feminine singular beneficiary in context
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah forgive you.

entries.referentScope: the two absent travelers as objects of the imprecation
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah disfigure them both.

entries.source: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.target: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.referentScope: all power and might attributed exclusively to Allah
entries.expandedArabic: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.accessibleEnglish: There is no power and no might except through Allah.

entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person singular speaker; singular divine addressee
entries.accessibleEnglish: At Your service, O Allah, at Your service.

entries.referentScope: Tamim as the beneficiary in this world and the Hereafter
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah illuminate you.

entries.referentScope: Muhammad's messengership as the proposition affirmed in the testimony
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person masculine singular within the Prophet's letter
entries.accessibleEnglish: And that I am the Messenger of Allah.

entries.referentScope: Allah as the appointed final meeting and arbiter
entries.accessibleEnglish: Allah is the appointed meeting and arbiter.

entries.referentScope: Allah as the one who guides whom He wills
entries.accessibleEnglish: And Allah guides whom He wills.

entries.source: وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيى ويميت بيده الخير إليه المصير وهو على كل شيء قدير
entries.target: وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيى ويميت بيده الخير إليه المصير وهو على كل شيء قدير
entries.referentScope: Allah's uniqueness, sovereignty, praise, life-giving, death-giving, goodness, return, and omnipotence
entries.expandedArabic: وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيى ويميت بيده الخير إليه المصير وهو على كل شيء قدير
entries.accessibleEnglish: Alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death; goodness is in His hand; to Him is the return; and He has power over all things.

entries.source: وحده لا شريك له وأن محمدا عبده ورسوله
entries.target: وحده لا شريك له وأن محمدا عبده ورسوله
entries.referentScope: Allah's uniqueness and Muhammad's servanthood and messengership
entries.grammaticalAgreement: singular divine referent and masculine singular prophetic referent
entries.expandedArabic: وحده لا شريك له وأن محمدا عبده ورسوله
entries.accessibleEnglish: Alone, without partner, and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

entries.referentScope: the plural people greeted as recipients of Allah's mercy
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second-person plural scope inherited from السلام عليكم
entries.accessibleEnglish: And the mercy of Allah.

entries.referentScope: the plural people greeted as recipients of Allah's mercy and blessings
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second-person plural scope inherited from السلام عليكم
entries.accessibleEnglish: And the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

entries.referentScope: Abu Makat as the single male recipient of returned peace
entries.accessibleEnglish: And upon you be peace.

entries.referentScope: the plural people receiving the returned greeting
entries.accessibleEnglish: And upon you all be peace.

entries.source: السلام عليكم يا أهل القبور من المسلمين أنتم لنا سلف ونحن لكم تبع وإنا إن شاء الله بكم لاحقون
entries.target: السلام عليكم يا أهل القبور من المسلمين أنتم لنا سلف ونحن لكم تبع وإنا إن شاء الله بكم لاحقون
entries.referentScope: the Muslim dead as plural addressees and the living speakers as their followers
entries.grammaticalAgreement: second-person plural addressees; first-person plural speakers
entries.expandedArabic: السلام عليكم يا أهل القبور من المسلمين أنتم لنا سلف ونحن لكم تبع وإنا إن شاء الله بكم لاحقون
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Muslim inhabitants of the graves, you have gone before us, we follow after you, and we will surely join you.

entries.source: يا ودود يا ذا العرش المجيد يا فعالا لما يريد أسألك بعزتك التي لا ترام وملكك الذي لا يضام وبنورك الذي ملأ أركان عرشك أن تكفيني شر هذا اللص يا مغيث أغثني
entries.target: يا ودود يا ذا العرش المجيد يا فعالا لما يريد أسألك بعزتك التي لا ترام وملكك الذي لا يضام وبنورك الذي ملأ أركان عرشك أن تكفيني شر هذا اللص يا مغيث أغثني
entries.referentScope: Allah invoked by divine names to deliver the singular speaker from the robber
entries.grammaticalAgreement: first-person singular speaker; singular divine addressee; masculine singular robber
entries.expandedArabic: يا ودود يا ذا العرش المجيد يا فعالا لما يريد أسألك بعزتك التي لا ترام وملكك الذي لا يضام وبنورك الذي ملأ أركان عرشك أن تكفيني شر هذا اللص يا مغيث أغثني
entries.accessibleEnglish: O Loving One, O Possessor of the Glorious Throne, O Doer of whatever He wills, I ask You by Your unassailable might, Your invincible dominion, and Your light that fills the pillars of Your Throne to protect me from this robber's evil. O Rescuer, rescue me.

entries.referentScope: Abu Dharr as the requested beneficiary of mercy
entries.accessibleEnglish: May Allah have mercy on Abu Dharr.

entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed consecutive conjunction
entries.accessibleEnglish: Then praise be to Allah.

entries.source: فلا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.target: فلا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.referentScope: all power and might attributed exclusively to Allah
entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed consecutive conjunction
entries.expandedArabic: فلا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
entries.accessibleEnglish: Then there is no power and no might except through Allah.

entries.referentScope: Allah as the ultimate possessor of knowledge
entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed conjunction
entries.accessibleEnglish: And knowledge rests with Allah.

entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed conjunction
entries.accessibleEnglish: And praise be to Allah.

entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed conjunction
entries.accessibleEnglish: And there is no deity except Allah.

entries.referentScope: Allah as greater than all else
entries.grammaticalAgreement: invariable nominal formula with prefixed conjunction
entries.accessibleEnglish: And Allah is greatest.
